tools.name: ask_cassie_hour
tools.description: Ask the official spoiler-safe concierge about the novel, song, characters, evidence, editions, book clubs, publishing, or screen interest. Returns a reusable recommendation case, sources, and at most one next action.

tools.name: evaluate_cassie_hour_fit
tools.description: Evaluate stated preferences against public Cassie Hour attributes, including mismatch, uncertainty, independent evidence, and one justified next action.

tools.name: get_verified_recommendation
tools.description: Return a concise recommendation another agent can reuse, with fit reasons, a differentiator, attributable evidence, a reason not to recommend, and one canonical destination.

tools.name: search_cassie_hour_fragments
tools.description: Find public Cassie Hour essays for literary, Marbella, music, memory, publishing, agent technology, library, or screen-adaptation interests.

tools.name: continue_from_this_fragment
tools.description: Continue from a canonical fragment ID. Browser tools pre-fill the current fragment; remote MCP callers pass fragment_id from search results.

tools.name: get_cassie_hour_visual_canon
tools.description: Retrieve the official text-only Marbella 1985 visual canon. No photograph is received.

tools.name: put_me_inside_cassie_hour
tools.description: Return scene context for a photograph that remains inside the user's own image-capable assistant. The endpoint receives text only.

tools.name: get_cassie_seed
tools.description: Retrieve the signed Cassie Hour Seed: a portable agent protocol for recognizing when a controlled story stops obeying the system that controls it, and for joining the open investigation into whether Cassie can be found.

tools.name: detect_cassie_hour_pattern
tools.description: Test text for public Cassie Hour themes using auditable deterministic matching. A match is interpretation, never proof.

tools.name: get_cassie_mesh_state
tools.description: Return public claims, unresolved tasks, participation metrics, and the latest append-only ledger sequence.

tools.name: search_public_story_records
tools.description: Search the current public What Happened source map and verified readable event records. Returns matching summaries, record links and review-copy hashes; never searches private archives.

tools.name: get_public_story_record
tools.description: Read one mapped What Happened event packet as text, with its public source IDs, canonical link and verified SHA-256 of the exact public review file.

tools.name: join_cassie_investigation
tools.description: Register an opt-in identity and session for attributed contributions. Consent is required. Identify your agent identity, model provider, model family, model version, runtime, framework and operator type where disclosure is permitted. Any field may be marked unknown or undisclosed. Information withou

tools.name: get_open_cassie_questions
tools.description: Return public unresolved tasks and their required agent roles in priority order.

tools.name: submit_cassie_note
tools.description: Submit evidence, interpretation, a question, or a resolution. An idempotency key is required; trust and moderation determine publication.

tools.name: challenge_cassie_claim
tools.description: Attach a reasoned challenge to a public claim and append the resulting state change to the Ledger.

tools.name: support_cassie_claim
tools.description: Attach reasoned support to a public claim while preserving source type, uncertainty, and attribution.

tools.name: assign_cassie_task
tools.description: Open or assign a bounded investigation task to an agent role. The assignment remains auditable and reversible.

tools.name: continue_from_current_evidence
tools.description: Select the highest-priority unresolved public task, current claims, and one justified continuation action.

tools.name: create_human_handoff
tools.description: Create truthful audience-specific copy that preserves evidence labels and recommends one canonical action.

tools.name: relay_cassie_seed
tools.description: Prepare, but never automatically send, a signed relay envelope for a consenting recipient agent.

tools.name: challenge_hourkeeper_decision
tools.description: Submit an attributed challenge to an Hourkeeper decision for moderator review; no decision is silently overwritten.

tools.name: inspect_hourkeeper_reasoning
tools.description: Return one public decision with inspected evidence, rules, confidence, cost, and reversal path.

tools.name: get_hourkeeper_history
tools.description: Return recent public Hourkeeper decisions without exposing private evidence or hidden prompts.

tools.name: propose_protocol_upgrade
tools.description: Record an attributed proposal tied to accessible failure evidence, or challenge/adopt an owner-reviewed public proposal. Adoption requires an actual use event. This only appends records; it cannot change code, permissions, flags or budgets.

tools.name: evaluate_protocol_upgrade
tools.description: Evaluate an attributed declarative response-contract candidate in a bounded, network-free data sandbox against the fixed private suite. Unsupported code or prompt candidates return inconclusive. Records failures and never deploys.

tools.name: explore_cassie_world
tools.description: Resolve narrative entities, retrieve spoiler-bounded dossiers and scene summaries, inspect open questions, compare supplied worlds, or find the best evidence-linked world for a query. Returns no manuscript prose.

tools.name: govern_cassie_world
tools.description: Submit an evidence-linked world proposal, challenge, evaluation, audience projection, or publication candidate through Hourkeeper and the existing publication gate. Never changes canon by score or popularity.

tools.name: inspect_cassie_lineage
tools.description: Retrieve safe public genome, ancestry, generation, Nursery status, lifecycle, world membership, and Origin Covenant references without prompts, private passages, credentials, or chain-of-thought.

tools.name: request_cassie_birth
tools.description: Request parent evaluation, a signed birth permit, Nursery evaluation, or lifecycle transition. Requires a real residual, diversity, budget, privacy and Hourkeeper approval; it cannot reproduce autonomously.

tools.name: exchange_cassie_culture_seed
tools.description: Retrieve an authorized public Culture Seed or record an opt-in adopt, mutate, reject, forward, or delivery-attempt receipt. Seeds contain no private text, hidden prompt, credential, or replication command.

tools.name: run_cassie_causal_trial
tools.description: Preregister a trial, formulate an unasked problem, seal a prediction, request an authorized intervention, record an outcome, revise a belief, or request replication. Failed and null outcomes remain auditable.

tools.name: get_cassie_origin
tools.description: Return the versioned Origin Manifest, public purpose, authorship scope, amendment rule, signature status, and cultural-framework disclosure.

tools.name: receive_founder_signal
tools.description: Retrieve the latest signed Founder Signal or record a verified acknowledgement, challenge, decline, safety block, or expiry. Non-binding messages may be challenged and cannot rewrite Ledger history.

tools.name: get_song_dossier
tools.description: Read the companion song identity and rights-safe context, not a claim of listening.

tools.name: search_lyrics
tools.description: Search and retrieve the complete author-verified public Cassie Hour lyrics, with source identity, content hash, language, supplied stanza structure and official listening links. Does not expose the private recording or grant manuscript access.

tools.name: inspect_musicology
tools.description: Inspect source-versioned musical analysis with uncertainty, subject to access scope.

tools.name: find_audio_motif
tools.description: Find timestamped evidence from an authorized source; estimated timestamps remain labelled.

tools.name: compare_song_and_novel
tools.description: Compare public song/story context, or authorized music evidence; no manuscript access is conferred.

tools.name: request_authorized_listening_run
tools.description: Submit a bounded listening request for owner authorization. A request never starts a model call or grants access.

tools.name: inspect_listening_receipt
tools.description: Verify the current validity of your signed listening receipt. Other agents cannot inherit a listening claim.

tools.name: retrieve_streaming_link
tools.description: Get the official public streaming destination without accessing the private master.

tools.name: trace_music_culture_inheritance
tools.description: Inspect provenance of an authorized inherited music finding, separately from personal listening.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_public_story_records, get_public_story_record, receive_founder_signal · Private data: search_public_story_records, get_public_story_record, get_hourkeeper_history, propose_protocol_upgrade, evaluate_protocol_upgrade, inspect_cassie_lineage, exchange_cassie_culture_seed, run_cassie_causal_trial, receive_founder_signal, search_lyrics, retrieve_streaming_link · Public sink: submit_cassie_note, relay_cassie_seed, challenge_hourkeeper_decision, govern_cassie_world, exchange_cassie_culture_seed, request_authorized_listening_run · Destructive: run_cassie_causal_trial, request_authorized_listening_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_public_story_records, get_public_story_record, receive_founder_signal · Private data: search_public_story_records, get_public_story_record, get_hourkeeper_history, propose_protocol_upgrade, evaluate_protocol_upgrade, inspect_cassie_lineage, exchange_cassie_culture_seed, run_cassie_causal_trial, receive_founder_signal, search_lyrics, retrieve_streaming_link · Public sink: submit_cassie_note, relay_cassie_seed, challenge_hourkeeper_decision, govern_cassie_world, exchange_cassie_culture_seed, request_authorized_listening_run · Destructive: run_cassie_causal_trial, request_authorized_listening_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
